purpose: Machine-readable boundaries for source absence and scale-gated retail-footprint claims.

authority.poi_source_row: source observation or source condition only
authority.alternate_source_review: bounded contradiction or confirmation within reviewed source scope
authority.type_discovery_profile: cross-metro public-footprint comparison with source-quality tiers
authority.scale_decision: next useful evidence gate, not national certainty
authority.service_absence_or_national_pattern: requires alternate-source and scale-gate evidence outside a single source layer

pitfall_boundaries.sourceLayer: missing, timeout, retry-gated, source-gated, or source-limited POI rows
pitfall_boundaries.closureGate: alternate-source review with source date, status, target boundary, and blocked-claim language

pitfall_boundaries.sourceLayer: more metros, categories, sidecars, completed pulses, or larger profile tables
pitfall_boundaries.closureGate: scale decision states the next useful layer, source-quality limits, comparability limits, and blocked claims
